about: Osc A of the init patch of the Audio Unit on a sine (a table of ours) at C4, Detune 1 (linear: voice j of n at 200 · (2j / (n - 1) - 1) cents), Width 1, the phase 0 of every voice: `levels` each voice of `u<n> <A Uni Blend>` [cents, left, right] (dB against one voice: the main lobe of a Hann at its peak; null not heard); `routes` u5 with Macro 1 routed to A Uni Blend (a mod slot of its state: kParamDetuneWid) at `amount` of its travel (uni, or `bipolar`) from the knob at `blend`, the macro at `level`; `moving` the blend from 0 up to 1 over 0.5..2.5 s and back to 0 at 4.5 s by the knob (automated) or Macro 1 (amount 1 from 0), at C7: [seconds, a centre voice in its left (u5 the middle one, u4 the lower of the middle two), the lowest one in its right] every 50 ms over 40 ms (Hann) against one voice; scripts/renders/run.mjs --only=blend
